notes.title: Sandara Soundtrack Release!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ZcNmPZbthf8;full][/previewyoutube]

The original soundtrack of Sandara has now been released!
Mira Aasma has composed a unique album specifically for Sandara. As the game's composer, she has crafted an original soundtrack that immerses you deeper into the world of Sandara.

➡️Take me to the live show from Save & Sound 2024⬅️

There are plenty more games from the Save & Sound Festival to discover - explore the incredible talent of this year's music and sound designers at the festival!

Buy the album and listen to the OST now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3187920/Sandara_Soundtrack/
